possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-output decoder-only model with no reported factuality or grounding evaluations -> plausible hallucination risk

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text model with no reported data handling or privacy safeguards -> users may send confidential prompts

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text model with no reported content filtering or IP safeguards -> users may include copyrighted material in prompts

possible_risks.description: 'A prompt leak attack attempts to extract a model's system prompt (also known as the system message).'
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text model with no reported system-prompt protection or evaluation -> system prompt may be extracted

specifications.model_size: 43.9 GiB of safetensors weights (47,144,848,872 bytes) in BF16
